summary: SFL Corp Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing a preliminary earnings press release for Q1 2026. The release reports operating revenues of $174 million, net income of $26 million ($0.20 per share), and a quarterly dividend increase to $0.22 per share. It also notes a $170 million drilling contract for the Hercules rig and refinancing of two rigs with $250 million in new credit facilities. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special-situations event. U.S. readers should view it as equivalent to an earnings press release under Form 8-K for domestic issuers. What to watch: ongoing dividend sustainability and charter backlog of $3.7 billion.
